description: This file configures Vitest testing environment specific to the 'extension-zalo' module within a larger project. It imports configuration paths and pattern loaders, defines functions to load include patterns from environment variables, and creates a scoped Vitest configuration for the Zalo extension, exporting the default configuration.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads file include patterns from environment variables or defaults to returning null.

methods.name: export function createExtensionZaloVitestConfig( createExtensionZaloVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a scoped Vitest configuration for the Zalo extension, with specific settings like test file patterns, environment, and setup files.
